articles.title: Illinois man accused of threatening Congress with white substances in letters marked with his return address
articles.description: Matthew Unglesbee allegedly told the FBI the white powder substance was salt and that he mailed the threatening letters to Congress as a joke.
articles.content:
An Illinois man was charged with two felonies Monday after allegedly sending letters containing an unknown white powder substance to members of Congress, according to a criminal complaint.
